L92: 
L93: All surfaces must be clean and tight fitting. Clear Gorilla Glue will stain clothes.
L94: 
L95: 1. Damp It
L96: 
L97: For non-porous surfaces only (i.e. metal, glass, plastics), lightly dampen one surface with water. Do not add water to bottle.
L98: 2. Glue It
L99: 
L100: Apply Clear Gorilla Glue to surfaces. Best at room temperature.
L101: 
L102: 3. Clamp It
L103: 
L104: Clamp objects together for 2 hours. Full cure in 24 hrs. You can use heavy objects to achieve clamping pressure.
L105: *Not recommended for use on polyethylene or polypropylene plastics. Storage Tips: After each use, wipe nozzle clean with a dry cloth and tightly replace lid. Store in a cool, dry place with exposure to light. Lack of light and heat can cause product to yellow. Cured glue can be removed from work surface with chisel, scraper or sandpaper. Store away from children and animals.
